patterns.note: Full-bleed imagery and dark background sections create a dramatic, immersive feel, often alternating with lighter sections for visual rhythm.
All-caps, bold sans-serif headings are consistently used for major section titles and product labels, establishing a strong, modern brand voice.
A high-contrast palette of deep black, crisp white, and subtle light grey backgrounds dominates, allowing product photography to provide the primary color accents.
A sticky header navigation maintains brand presence, while the initial hero section uses a subtle parallax effect where foreground text scrolls over a slower-moving background image.
Product listings are presented in a clean, uniform grid, with each item featuring a large, high-quality photograph and minimal, consistent text styling.

technique_notes: A fixed header navigation bar is used, ensuring key links and branding are always accessible at the top of the viewport.
The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where the main content scrolls over a large, fixed or slow-moving background image, creating a sense of depth and visual interest.
Content sections are introduced with subtle, scroll-triggered fade-in or slide-up animations, likely using CSS keyframes, to progressively reveal information as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, all-caps sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all UI elements and image containers, contributing to a modern, precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive use of stark black and white photography combined with minimal, bold typography creates an almost gallery-like experience for its products. It elevates non-alcoholic beverages to a luxury item through sophisticated visual presentation, rather than relying on typical vibrant lifestyle imagery.
